articles.summary: Earlier this month we announced that Keypo has joined Multifactor. This is the story of the problem, the two halves we each solved, and what we're building now that we're one company.
articles.title: Keypo + Multifactor: A founder’s reflection on the acquisition

articles.summary: We're proud to share that Multifactor has acquired Keypo, Inc., a programmable encryption company. Keypo's founder, Dave Blumenfeld, is staying on as Multifactor's Founding Engineer.
articles.title: Multifactor acquires Keypo to accelerate zero-trust security for AI agents
